title: Lost & Found
escalation: Please have your child check with the school office, or contact the office directly for next steps. This bot cannot see Lost & Found inventory and cannot contact staff for you.

identify_item.prompt: I can help! What did your child lose?

clothing_checked.prompt: Has your child checked both Lost & Found locations — the cafeteria and outside the gym?

clothing_not_yet.prompt: Ask your child to check both locations during the school day. Students are generally expected to retrieve their own belongings.

clothing_checked_office.prompt: Have your child check with the school office and look again later in case the item has been turned in.

student_id_answer.prompt: Parents reported that a replacement student ID costs $5 and can be obtained through the school office.

chromebook_answer.prompt: Please notify your child's teacher and the school office. The technology team will create a missing-device report and contact you within two school days. [DEMO ANSWER]

bus_answer.prompt: Contact First Student with the bus number and route details. Parents reported that some drivers keep found items until the following morning.
